core_meaning.primary_meaning: Afdal is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Better, best”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Afdal corresponds to the Arabic form أفضل (Arabic root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l); أَفْضَل (afḍal)). Its core sense is better; best. Afdal is Arabic أَفْضَل (afḍal) 'Better, best', the elative ('better, best') form built on the root ف ض ل (f-ḍ-l). Afdal is a variant romanization of Afzal.
